Fixed. Summary of the changes:

**Root cause:** In `@SuperBuilder`, the builder setter javadoc was read from the wrong node — the *generated builder field* (`fieldNode`, which has no javadoc) instead of the *original class field* (`originalFieldNode`). So every generated setter only got `@return {@code this}.` appended, losing the description and `@param` docs.

**Fix:**
- `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleSuperBuilder.java:1073` — replaced the inline (buggy) javadoc block with `copyJavadoc(originalFieldNode, newMethod, CopyJavadoc.SETTER, true)`, the same mechanism `@Builder` uses (`HandleBuilder.java:940`), which handles SETTER sections, `@param`/`@return` stripping, and the cleanup task.
- `src/core/lombok/eclipse/handlers/HandleSuperBuilder.java:1014` — the ecj handler had no javadoc copying at all; added `copyJavadoc(originalFieldNode, setter, td, CopyJavadoc.SETTER, true)` mirroring `HandleBuilder.java:1058`.

**Validation** (all in the container):
- `ant test.instance` (TestWithDelombok): 398 tests, 0 failures — `javac-SuperBuilderJavadoc` now passes (was the failing case)
- `ant test.ecj11` (TestWithEcj): passes — `ecj-SuperBuilderJavadoc` now passes
- `ant test.javacCurrent` and `ant test.eclipse-202212`: pass, no regressions
